Name: Kats Statue Obelisks
Author: Kattiana
Description:
This is a simple content patcher mod that turns the obelisks into smaller statues with a base. The statues change color based on the seasons to match the farms mouse teleport statue, with one exception being winter. I found the winter color to be so horribly green, so I went ahead and changed it to a muted grey. The statues have had a small facelift from the vanilla look, and the statues out in the world have been recolored to match.

This mod uses Content Patcher to edit tilesheets and so should be compatible with just about anything.

All my mods are provided on an "as-is" basis, and will not be supported beyond current release.
